update_active_memory.description: Allows the model to update state fields already fixed on an active memory record.
rules: Use UPDATE_ACTIVE_MEMORY only to change values of custom state fields that already exist on the target active memory record.
Never create, rename, or delete fields during UPDATE_ACTIVE_MEMORY. The field schema is fixed when SAVE_ACTIVE_MEMORY creates the record.
Never update runtime-owned fields such as active_memory_id, conditions, status, creation_time, updated_at, elapsed_time, session ids, or message counters.
active_memory_id is a placeholder; replace it with the exact six-character id from <ACTIVE_MEMORY>.
Each body line must contain one existing custom field name and its new value. Update only fields that actually changed. Keep each new value concise (maximum 256 characters).
